# Starting armies (and fleets) for centralized nations of 00_isekai.
# Composition follows tech: irregular hordes for tier 3/4 or no-arms nations;
# line infantry + (cavalry/Mages where cultivation-capable) + (artillery where produced)
# for regulars. Fleets (frigates) only for kingdom-tier+ regulars with a coast.
# Nations are grouped by the thematic region of their capital.
# Generated by tools/gen_military.py.
MILITARY_FORMATIONS = {
	c:ACA ?= {
		create_military_formation = {
			type = army
			hq_region = sr:region_isekai
			save_scope_as = ACA_army_1
			combat_unit = {
				type = unit_type:combat_unit_type_line_infantry
				state_region = s:STATE_ACADEMY_DISTRICT
				count = 11
			}
			combat_unit = {
				type = unit_type:combat_unit_type_hussars
				state_region = s:STATE_ACADEMY_DISTRICT
				count = 2
			}
		}
		create_character = {
			is_general = yes
			interest_group = ig_armed_forces
			commander_rank = commander_rank_1
			save_scope_as = ACA_general_1
		}
		scope:ACA_general_1 = { transfer_to_formation = scope:ACA_army_1 }
	}

		scope:VAL_general_1 = { transfer_to_formation = scope:VAL_army_1 }
		create_military_formation = {
			type = army
			hq_region = sr:region_isekai
			save_scope_as = VAL_army_2
			combat_unit = {
				type = unit_type:combat_unit_type_line_infantry
				state_region = s:STATE_LORRLAND
				count = 16
			}
			combat_unit = {
				type = unit_type:combat_unit_type_hussars
				state_region = s:STATE_LORRLAND
				count = 4
			}
			combat_unit = {
				type = unit_type:combat_unit_type_line_infantry
				state_region = s:STATE_HAVENSTRY
				count = 13
			}
			combat_unit = {
				type = unit_type:combat_unit_type_hussars
				state_region = s:STATE_HAVENSTRY
				count = 2
			}
		}
		create_character = {
			is_general = yes
			interest_group = ig_armed_forces
			commander_rank = commander_rank_2
			save_scope_as = VAL_general_2
		}
		scope:VAL_general_2 = { transfer_to_formation = scope:VAL_army_2 }
		create_military_formation = {
			type = fleet
			hq_region = sr:region_isekai
			save_scope_as = VAL_fleet_1
			ship = {
				type = ship_type:ship_type_frigate
				count = 20
			}
		}
		create_character = {
			is_admiral = yes
			interest_group = ig_armed_forces
			commander_rank = commander_rank_2
			save_scope_as = VAL_admiral_1
		}
		scope:VAL_admiral_1 = { transfer_to_formation = scope:VAL_fleet_1 }
	}
	c:VIN ?= {
		create_military_formation = {
			type = army
			hq_region = sr:region_isekai
			save_scope_as = VIN_army_1
			combat_unit = {
				type = unit_type:combat_unit_type_line_infantry
				state_region = s:STATE_STJERNVIK
				count = 9
			}
			combat_unit = {
				type = unit_type:combat_unit_type_hussars
				state_region = s:STATE_STJERNVIK
				count = 2
			}
		}
		create_character = {
			is_general = yes
			interest_group = ig_armed_forces
			commander_rank = commander_rank_1
			save_scope_as = VIN_general_1
		}
		scope:VIN_general_1 = { transfer_to_formation = scope:VIN_army_1 }
	}
}
